description: Source code implementing chunk-based file format handling, including structures and functions for managing chunks, reading/writing chunk tables, and hash algorithm versioning.

classes.name: chunk_info
classes.description: Represents individual chunks with ID, size, write function, and start pointer.

classes.name: chunkfile
classes.description: Manages collection of chunks within a file, including initialization, cleanup, and chunk operations.

classes.name: pair_chunk_data
classes.description: Holds pointers for returning chunk data and size during chunk reading.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a chunkfile structure with a given hashfile.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a chunkfile.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the number of chunks in a chunkfile.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a new chunk to the chunkfile with specified ID, size, and write function.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes all chunks and their table of contents to the hashfile.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads and parses the table of contents from a memory-mapped file into the chunkfile structure.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Retrieves a specific chunk's data and size by chunk ID.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads a chunk by ID using a provided callback function.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Returns the version number of the hash algorithm used.
